notes.title: Unveloped July 2021 Patch
notes.notes: Over the month of July, a new title update will be rolled out improving on controller pad support along with a refresh of the main title screen. There will also be some fine tweaking to player movement and graphics. Expect more soon.....

notes.notes: Unveloped is on sale until July 9th.
